title: Wat Pa Tam Wua — round 5 (structural pass)
notes: Applied your highlights + a full coherence rewrite: no trailing …, phone/cafe rules said once, alms in prose, Clarity book after the monastery, knower via walking, books linked with Siddhartha later. Below are the remaining structural / phrasing calls I’d push if this were my draft.

proposals.before: Four Noble Truths + Eightfold Path + three characteristics + Satipatthana — still a lot of list density after a personal essay.
proposals.after:
Option A: keep Truths + characteristics; fold Eightfold into one sentence under Magga; move Satipatthana into Meditation (it’s practice, not doctrine).
Option B: keep as-is for readers who want the map.
proposals.rationale: After the rewrite, Buddhism is still the section most likely to feel like notes. Satipatthana especially belongs next to the walking/sitting practice.

proposals.summary: Move Stoicism earlier or cut it
proposals.before: Stoicism h3 sits between neuroscience and China — two hard topic jumps.
proposals.after:
Option A: one sentence after the ‘rational people’ para (‘Closest Western cousin I’ve found is Stoicism: revise judgments vs watch feelings pass.’) and drop the h3.
Option B: keep the h3 but put it right after the Buddhist-philosophy paragraph.
Option C: keep current.
proposals.rationale: It’s good content in a slightly awkward slot. I’d take A for flow.

proposals.summary: Shorten the technique paragraph a notch
proposals.before: Still the longest single paragraph in the post.
proposals.after: Keep the sequence (deep breaths → nose point → less distraction → visuals → absorption) but drop one clause — e.g. the ‘at home this happens a lot’ contrast, or merge the two ‘deeper state’ sentences.
proposals.rationale: You wanted the detail kept; this is the residual readability issue on mobile.

proposals.before: The monastery was amazing — I've never felt as much inner peace and clarity.
proposals.after:
Option A: keep (your voice).
Option B: ‘The monastery gave me more inner peace and clarity than I’ve felt before.’ — same claim, less review-speak.
proposals.rationale: ‘Amazing’ is fine in speech; on the page it’s the softest word left in the intro. Easy reject.

proposals.summary: Split science books from monastery books
proposals.before: One long mixed list (monastery PDFs + Hesse + neuroscience).
proposals.after: Two short lists: ‘At the monastery’ and ‘Since / reading now’ — or keep one list but with those as bold subheads inside the ul context via two paragraphs.
proposals.rationale: The list got long after adding Kindle science titles. Grouping helps skimming.

proposals.before: it feels a bit like Avatar.
proposals.after: Keep, or swap for something less pop-culture (‘like a film set between two limestone walls’). Your call — grammar is fine now.
proposals.rationale: Cleared the grammar issue; only asking if the reference still feels right to you.

locate.find: it feels a bit like Avatar

proposals.before: Meditation ends on the gym metaphor; Buddhism opens cold with Theravada taxonomy.
proposals.after: Add after the gym line: ‘A lot of what I was feeling only made sense once I had a bit of the Buddhist map — still learning, so treat the next section as notes.’
proposals.rationale: Connects the experiential half to the conceptual half without another heading.
